[[File:Homogeneous and isometric spacetime expansion.png|thumbnail|2D analogy: Homogeneous expansion on a two-dimensional grid. The expansions observed from A's perspective (left) and B's (right) are identical.]]
The '''Copernican principle''' states that

# the [[Earth]] does not occupy a special position in the [[Universe]],
# the conditions of the universe observed from earth are typical of those seen by observers on distant galaxies.
